notes: D1 oracle is the official Luas Network Map PNG (DatoCMS asset 225949/1784119177, linked from https://www.luas.ie/luas-map/) HAND-TRANSCRIBED from the rendered image by this pack — the oracle report explicitly deferred this step. Not generated from GTFS, not generated from routes.txt, not generated from Wikipedia.

City id dublin is unused in existing packs. Display Dublin. Agency Luas (Keolis / NTA). Do not invent city=dub, city=ie, or merge into a national multi-city Irish feed. Do not edit any other city. Do not flip live.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: Luas Red + Green light rail only. OUT: DART/Iarnród Éireann (commuter rail, v2), Dublin Bus, Bus Éireann, Go-Ahead Ireland (buses, out of mode). No premetro, no bus.

Timezone Europe/Dublin. The oracle report's 'no daylight saving observed since 2024' claim is UNVERIFIED and likely incorrect (the EU/Ireland clock-change abolition proposal stalled and was never enacted) — do not hand-roll a fixed-offset table; use the IANA tzdatabase identifier Europe/Dublin directly so real transition rules are picked up automatically. See hazard-pack.md H7.

Red Line: 32 unique stops. Two southwestern branches fork at Belgard — Tallaght (via Cookstown, Hospital) and Saggart (via Fettercairn, Cheeverstown, Citywest Campus, Fortunestown) — sharing one common trunk east to The Point. No printed route number; Luas brands by colour only.

Green Line: 35 unique stops. Broombridge (north) to Brides Glen (south), with a one-way city-centre loop between Parnell and Trinity: O'Connell - GPO and O'Connell Upper are northbound-only (towards Broombridge); Marlborough is southbound-only (towards Brides Glen). See cityCentreLoop below and direction-model-memo.md — this is the sharpest hazard in this pack.

Locked hub: Abbey Street (Red Line trunk stop, between Jervis and Busáras; confirmed by dot position on the official map). Not Connolly (Red only, DART interchange, no Green access). Green interchange (Marlborough / O'Connell - GPO / O'Connell Upper) is a ~200 m walk, not a shared platform — Abbey Street boards must never show a Green chip.

doNotGroup Abbey Street vs Marlborough / O'Connell - GPO / O'Connell Upper (hub vs walkable Green cluster). doNotGroup O'Connell - GPO vs O'Connell Upper (two distinct Green stops, same name family, direction-exclusive). doNotGroup Tallaght vs Saggart (two distinct Red termini forking at Belgard). doNotGroup Red Cow vs Kingswood vs Belgard (three consecutive distinct stops; Belgard, not Red Cow, is the actual fork).

gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown intentionally omitted: Luas has no printed route number on the official map (colour-only branding). Jim must verify actual GTFS route_id values against the NTA static feed in D2 — do not invent them here.
P&R / bus / bike / accessibility icons printed next to some stop names (e.g. 'P&R Red Cow', 'Tallaght P&R') are amenity tags, stripped from the D1 stop names below (Red Cow, Tallaght).

Feed / live (Jim D2, not a D1 generator): NTA GTFS-RT v2 TripUpdates + Vehicles via developer.nationaltransport.ie (x-api-key header). Never paste a key. D1 stays planned. assertCityLive("dublin") must fail (city is not in lib/providers/registry.js CITIES today — Unknown city / 400).

hubLock.lockNote: Red Line trunk stop between Jervis and Busáras. Not a direction token — never print 'to Abbey Street' / 'to City' / 'to Centre'.
hubLock.walkableInterchangeNote: ~200 m walk, same operator (Luas/Keolis), same fare system (Leap Card / TFI). No shared platform — never printed as if Green trains call at Abbey Street.

cityCentreLoop.note: One-way loop on the official map: two parallel tracks with opposite-direction arrows. Northbound-only and southbound-only stops must never be shown the wrong direction on a board. See direction-model-memo.md and hazard-pack.md H4a.

coverageGaps: DART / Iarnród Éireann commuter rail. Deferred to v2 per oracle report. Not inserted.
Dublin Bus, Bus Éireann, Go-Ahead Ireland. Out of v1 mode cut (buses). Not inserted.

Peak-time short workings (e.g. Green trips turning at Sandyford or Dundrum) are not printed on the official network map and are not represented in shortTurns. Possible D2 finding once GTFS-RT trip headsigns are examined.
Fare zones (Zone Red 1-4, Zone Green 1-5 printed on the same map plate) are fare metadata, not stop-graph data. Not inserted.
